symptom: ako/mxcli#1941 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1737): `retrieve $Companies from M.Company offset 5000;` (no limit) was written as the 'all' range — Microflows$ConstantRange, SingleObject false — so re-running the script silently made the retrieve return the first objects instead of skipping 5000; describe then printed no offset. `limit 10 offset 5000` and `limit 10` were unaffected.
cause: addRetrieveAction built a Custom range only when `s.Limit != ""`; the offset-only case fell through to no range (the writer's default ConstantRange), although the comment above it already said 'a limit or offset the Custom range'. The writer (rangeToGen) and describe both handled an empty limit correctly.
file: mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder_actions.go (addRetrieveAction: Custom range when a limit OR an offset is stated)
insight: A condition keyed on one of two optional fields that together decide a shape is the silent-property-drop pattern in one line: grep for the sibling field in the same branch. Settled by the stored BSON (ConstantRange vs CustomRange) rather than by describe alone, and by mx check 11.12.6 on a fresh project: a CustomRange with OffsetExpression and no LimitExpression is 0 errors, so it is a model Mendix accepts. Test fails with range = <nil> before the fix, for mdl 0 and mdl 1.
